text: {"name":"phy_rf_calibration_apply","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Applies per-vif RF calibration table pointers, issues WLC calibration commands, and triggers PHY calibration when the calibration state indicates it is required.","subsystem":"phy","var_renames":{"v1":"phy_state_base","v2":"phy_vif_state","v3":"rf_cal_ctx_idx","v4":"vif_idx","v5":"rf_calib_ptr","v6":"rf_cal_unit_idx","v7":"rf_cal_unit","v8":"rf_calib_enable_2","v10":"rf_cal_state_base","v11":"rf_cal_state","v12":"rf_cal_ready_flag","v19":"rf_channel_profile_ptr","v22":"rf_cal_cmd_value"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":34,"meaning":"RF calibration context selector, such as band/channel table index"},{"offset":584,"meaning":"First per-vif RF calibration table/array slot, used as a 5-entry table"},{"offset":624,"meaning":"Second per-vif RF calibration table/array slot, used as a 5-entry table"},{"offset":44,"meaning":"Pointer to additional channel or RF calibration profile"},{"offset":36,"meaning":"Calibration mode or periodic-calibration flag"},{"offset":106,"meaning":"RF calibration context valid/ready byte"},{"offset":116,"meaning":"RF calibration context status byte, reset to -1 before start"},{"offset":234,"meaning":"RF calibration periodic countdown or interval byte"},{"offset":107,"meaning":"RF calibration counter adjacent to periodic state"}]}
